provenance.anim: AnimDef feeds gfx, animation-header pointer tables and tiles to func_08019068; the named family wrappers access canonical 16-byte records. Record bounds follow recorded consumers; EmyDef default sequences use indices 0,1,2. The standalone Mushu fifth record is a structurally validated continuation, not a claimed runtime index.
provenance.enemy: Each task passes its EmyDef into func_0800C778; emy_common.c passes the embedded EmyKind at offset28 to func_0801B37C, which consumes its complete16-byte structure.
provenance.hum: HumInit likewise consumes a16-byte EmyKind at offset12. HumWork.unk_184 aliases Actor.unk_184; btl_actor.c:433 accesses cards0..2, proving each card-ID triplet.
provenance.regions: Every corresponding pointer votes unanimously across all records and both target regions. All nonpointer bytes agree except two HumDef first fields in EU (128 to100 and128 to102), expressed with local version guards.
provenance.frd_ownership: Seven friend-task animation tables and their adjacent task names form the same complete read-only group in US, JP and EU. Every table is used only by the corresponding friend lifecycle in frd.c, and each name is referenced by its matching callback descriptor in the aggregate descriptor catalog. The table/name sequence matches callback family order, and ordinary const C definitions plus native compiler alignment reproduce the original spans without per-object sections. The shared names remain declared for the aggregate descriptors.
